description: List your workspace's hosted price scrape jobs: each one's id, name, page url, selectors, schedule and whether it is enabled. Hosted scraping is behind a release flag: until it is on for your workspace this answers 501 hosted_scraping_not_enabled. Runs honour robots.txt and fetch only public https pages. Needs a Last Price credential with the commerce:catalog:read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: list_scrape_jobs
